log_level.description: Logging level for scheduler messages (debug, info, warning, error, critical)

log_file.description: Path to scheduler log file; empty string logs to stderr

state_path.description: Base directory for scheduler state, lock files, and temporary data

transport_url.description: Message broker connection URL (e.g., RabbitMQ or Redis)

default_volume_type.description: Name of the default volume type to use when not specified

max_gigs_per_tenant.description: Maximum total size (in GB) of volumes that can be created per tenant

max_snapshots_per_tenant.description: Maximum number of snapshots a tenant can create

max_backups_per_tenant.description: Maximum number of backups a tenant can create

max_backup_gigs.description: Maximum total backup size (in GB) allowed per tenant

default_volume_type_create.description: Whether to automatically create the default volume type if missing

scheduler_default_filters.description: List of scheduler filter classes to apply when selecting a host

scheduler_default_weighers.description: List of scheduler weigher classes to rank hosts after filtering

workers.description: Number of separate scheduler worker processes (for horizontal scaling)

api_rate_limit.description: Enable or disable rate limiting on scheduler API endpoints

api_debug.description: Enable verbose logging of all API requests and responses

volume_allocate_retries.description: Number of times to retry volume allocation before failing

volume_allocate_retry_interval.description: Seconds to wait between volume allocation retries

enable_cross_tenant_clone.description: Allow cloning volumes across tenants (requires backend support)

enable_cross_tenant_snapshot_restore.description: Allow restoring volumes from snapshots owned by other tenants

enable_consistency_groups.description: Enable consistency group operations (for application-consistent snapshots)

enable_replication.description: Enable volume replication across backends or sites

migration_confirm_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for a volume migration confirmation before auto-aborting

scheduler_host_subset_size.description: Number of best hosts to randomly choose from after filtering (>=1)

scheduler_use_bare_host.description: Disable weighting; select the first matching host after filtering

scheduler_available_backends.description: List of backend names to consider for scheduling (empty = all enabled)

backends.description: List of storage backends to register with the scheduler

name.description: Backend name (must match section name in cinder.conf)

driver.description: Fully qualified class path of the volume driver

target_ip.description: IP address of the backend iSCSI/NFS target (optional)

availability_zones.description: Mapping of availability zones to lists of backend names (for zone-aware scheduling)

debug.description: Enable full debug logging (verbose, for troubleshooting only)
